_note: Templates. {UPPERCASE} blocks are drawn fresh; {lowercase} fields are what the story kept; {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} pick up something an earlier beat introduced (favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't). Entries with tags are favored in those genres.
entries: told {CLOSE} the truth, and immediately regretted it
started asking questions nobody in {place} wanted answered
wrote a letter to {CLOSE} and actually sent it
decided, for once, to say yes

entries.text: saddled up and rode out before dawn
buried something and told no one where
strapped on the old gun belt
wired a friend two territories away
took the first stage out of {place}, then got off at the next stop
put the word out that they were looking for {SOMEONE}
followed the path into the wood
made a bargain with {SOMEONE} and didn't read the terms
sewed {THING} into the hem of a coat
set out across the hills with a loaf of bread and a bad feeling
told no one and went to {landmark} by night
gave away the last coin and kept {THING}
tried to hide {THING} from the {rival}, and did it badly

entries: read {the_message} again and again, looking for what it left out
